get.description: Catalog bikes whose make, model and year contain every word of `q`.

post.description: Counter staff are done with the triage: draft the work order for the mechanic.

Answer the questions or fix the notes, then triage again. The paused run is finished
as `revised` first, so its trace ends cleanly instead of hanging at the pause.

The customer doesn't want the work: keep a declined record and release the bike. A
safety-critical decline needs a signed waiver (the database enforces it too).

The bike couldn't be resolved, so the run stopped: re-run with the bike staff picked,
or with the bike marked unconfirmed (labor only; the mechanic identifies it).

get.description: The review queue is `status=awaiting_review`: safety-critical first, then newest.

Parts of a category for the order's bike, split into compatible and unverified, for
the mechanic adding a line. Orders without a catalog bike have no parts to offer.

put.description: Replace the lines of a draft awaiting review, checked like the agent's own drafts.

post.description:
Thumbs up or down on the agent's work. One vote per person per order; sending another
replaces it. See online/ratings.py for what a vote does in LangSmith.

The compatibility engine's verdict, with the reasons and the specs it compared. This is
the code the agent can't override: the model never decides whether a part fits.

the judges, the mechanic's decision and the thumbs. Reads LangSmith, so only when tracing
is on; otherwise it says so rather than failing.
